backfillWorkspaceProjectProgress.reason: Flag-off startup backfill. Bounded startup dispatches to backfillInstalledProjectProgress, which checks project frames for empty histories and streams changed histories through the bounded metadata writer.

persistIssueMetadata.reason: Bounded stores never read its resident copy: TestPersistIssueMetadataCallset proves the only reference is UpdateIssueRecord's else branch of projectInputs != nil and that projectInputs is assigned only in the bounded issueProjectInputsSupported branch (siblings: issueHotInputsSupported and a coverage refusal), so a bounded store reaches it only with the non-project hot inputs, where the legacy writer returns no metadata. The bounded branch (refuseBoundedHotIssueMetadata) returns nil exactly there and refuses project progress or a team move instead of skipping it against the policy copy. Flag off is unchanged. TestBoundedIssueMetadataRefusal compares legacy and bounded outcomes (plain edit, duplicate family rows, empty family, project progress, project join, team move with and without documents) with zero decodes; TestScaleHotIssueInputsUpdateDifferential covers the end-to-end hot update.
